# Progress monitoring cycle2

We want to track the progress of monitoring cycle 2 of MHQ for the terrestrial habitat types. 

To do this we use we compare (1) the original sample for MHQ cycle 2 (`mhq_terr_sample_c2`) with
(2) the standardized tables of the assessments and measurements.

The assessments table also contains assessment for monitoring cycle 1. 
We can identify the assessments for monitoring cycle 2, based on the start year of monitoring cycle 2.
The start year is different per type, and is documented in the table `mhq_terr_moncycle.csv`.
See table below.

```{r, message = FALSE}
path <- fileman_up("n2khab-mhq-design")

mhq_terr_sample <- read_vc("mhq_terr_sample_c2",
                           file.path(path, "mhq_terr_cycle2/output")) %>%
    mutate(main_type = as.character(main_type))

mhq_terr_relocations <- read_vc("mhq_terr_relocations_c2",
                           file.path(path, "mhq_terr_cycle2/output"))

mhq_terr_moncycle <- read_csv2(file.path(path, "overzicht_mhq/data/mhq_terr_moncycle.csv"),
                               col_types =  "ciii")
```

```{r}

path_mhq_terr <- "../../data/mhq_terr/v2026"

mhq_terr_assessments <- read_vc("mhq_terr_assessments", 
                                root = path_mhq_terr)

mhq_terr_refpoints <- read_vc("mhq_terr_refpoints", 
                                root = path_mhq_terr) 
    
mhq_terr_measurements <- read_vc("mhq_terr_measurements", 
                                root = path_mhq_terr)

val <- read_vc("mhq_terr_measurements_validation", 
                                root = "../../data/mhq_terr/")

```

```{r}
check_coords_sample <- mhq_terr_sample %>%
    select(point_code, type, reassessment, x, y) %>%
    left_join(mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
                  select(point_code, x_ref = x, y_ref = y, grts_ranking_refpoint = grts_ranking),
              by = "point_code") %>%
    mutate(distance = sqrt((x - x_ref) ^ 2 + (y - y_ref) ^ 2) %>%
               round(2)) %>%
    filter(distance > 1) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 31370, remove = FALSE)

grts_master <- read_GRTSmh()

check_coords_sample <- check_coords_sample %>%
    mutate(grts_check = (terra::extract(grts_master,check_coords_sample))$GRTSmaster_habitats)
```

```{r}
mhq_terr_moncycle %>%
    datatable(rownames = FALSE,
              filter = "top")
```

We also have to take the relocations into account. 
We have to link the measurements in the relocated sampling units with the original sampling unit in mhq_terr_sample_c2.
This can be done with the function `detect_relocations`.

```{r}

detect_relocations <- function(assessments = mhq_terr_assessments, refpoints = mhq_terr_refpoints){
    
    assessments_relocation <- assessments %>%
        separate_wider_delim(point_code, delim = "_", names = c("point_code_base", "point_code_suffix"), cols_remove = FALSE) %>%
        group_by(point_code_base, assessment_date) %>%
        filter(any(change_location)) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        mutate(point_code_type = ifelse(change_location, "relocation", "orig")) %>%
        group_by(assessment_date, point_code_base, point_code, point_code_type, assessment_source, is_present) %>%
        summarise(type = str_c(type, collapse = "; ")) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        pivot_wider(values_from = c(point_code, type, is_present), names_from = point_code_type) %>%
        select(assessment_date, point_code = point_code_orig, point_code_relocation, type = type_relocation, is_present = is_present_relocation, assessment_source) %>%
        left_join(mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
                      select(point_code, x, y),
                  by = "point_code") %>%
        left_join(mhq_terr_refpoints %>%
                      select(point_code_relocation = point_code, x_relocation = x, y_relocation = y),
                  by = "point_code_relocation") %>%
        mutate(distances_relocation = sqrt((x_relocation - x) ^ 2 + (y_relocation - y) ^ 2)) %>%
        select(-x, -y, -x_relocation, -y_relocation)
    
    return(assessments_relocation)

}

```

```{r}

relocations <- detect_relocations()

start_c2 <- mhq_terr_moncycle %>%
    filter(mon_cycle == 2) %>%
    select(main_type, mon_cycle, year_start)

assessments_c2 <- mhq_terr_assessments %>%
    anti_join(relocations, by = c("point_code", "assessment_date")) %>%
    bind_rows(relocations %>%
                  mutate(change_location = TRUE)) %>%
    inner_join(mhq_terr_sample %>%
                  select(point_code, type_target_c2 = type),
              by = "point_code") %>%
    mutate(main_type_target_c2 = str_sub(type_target_c2, 1, 4)) %>%
    left_join(start_c2, by = c("main_type_target_c2" = "main_type")) %>%
    filter(year(assessment_date) >= year_start) %>%
    mutate(point_code_measured = ifelse(is.na(point_code_relocation), point_code, point_code_relocation))

measurements_c2 <- mhq_terr_measurements %>%
    semi_join(assessments_c2, by = c("point_code", "measurement_date" = "assessment_date"))

nrow(assessments_su_orig) == nrow(mhq_terr_assessments)
 
check <- mhq_terr_assessments %>%
    anti_join(assessments_su_orig, by = c("point_code", "assessment_date"))
 


progress_c2 <- mhq_terr_sample %>%
    rename(type_target = type, main_type_target = main_type) %>%
    left_join(assessments_su_orig, by = "point_code") %>%
    filter(year(assessment_date) >= year_start | is.na(assessment_date)) #opname 2de cyclus of nog niet opgemeten

nrow(progress_c2) == nrow(mhq_terr_sample)
```
